dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: How long have you felt nauseous?

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He has also eaten much less than usual.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Did you start any new medication before the nausea began?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I started a new antibiotic five days ago.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: The nausea seemed to begin the following day.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Do you know the name of the antibiotic?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I do not remember the name, but I take one tablet twice a day.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Any diarrhea or significant abdominal pain?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No diarrhea. I only have mild stomach discomfort from time to time.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He skipped dinner yesterday because the smell of food made the nausea worse.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Are you still able to drink water normally?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes. Drinking is fine, and I have been trying to drink regularly.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Good. We should review the antibiotic and consider whether it may be causing these symptoms.
